run_humanoid_benchmark: run the pybullet humanoid simulation benchmark that profiles 1000 physics steps and logs timings to JSON
load_mjcf_humanoid: load a humanoid MJCF model into pybullet and reset its base position and orientation
reset_joint_states: reset all joint states of a pybullet body using a list of joint position values
profile_physics_timings: start and stop pybullet state logging to profile physics simulation step timings
configure_physics_engine: configure pybullet physics engine parameters including gravity, solver iterations, fixed time step, and sub steps
